summary: Created Redux state structure for SMS message management. Installed @reduxjs/toolkit and react-redux, created sms.types.js with JSDoc type definitions (MessageStatus enum, Message and SmsState interfaces), created smsSlice.js with reducers (addMessage, updateMessageStatus, removeMessage, setLoading, setError) and selectors (selectAllMessages, selectMessageById, selectPendingMessages, selectMessagesByStatus), configured the Redux store in store/index.js, and wrapped the App with the Redux Provider in main.jsx.
